notes: Ignore the outer gray showcase canvas, rounded presentation frame, and frame drop shadow.

Preserve the real product stage top/left boundary and directional shell-edge shadow even though the outer showcase wrapper is ignored.

Record the main-stage shell as slightly inset from the app canvas: the outer shell owns the top offset, top/left border, clipping, and xs directional shadow; an inner pane owns scrolling and contains the sticky opaque topbar.
Apply boundary ownership: the vertical boundary beside the navigation belongs to the adjacent main/profile workspace edge, not to the sidebar.
Preserve the main-stage shell's asymmetric radius: the top-left corner is rounded while the other shell corners remain square.
